name: 물결 · 저승길 차림
hair: 물에 젖은 듯한 진한 남색 단발
outfit: 진한 청색의 잠수복 형태의 한복 저고리
weapon: 빛나는 푸른 보석이 박힌 은색 작살
silhouette: 긴 작살을 든 단단한 체구, 몸 주변을 떠다니는 작은 물방울 조각들
signature_motion: 작살을 뒤로 젖혔다가 앞으로 강하게 찌르는 동작
signature_vfx: 작살이 지나간 자리에 남는 푸른빛의 물결 궤적과 터지는 물보라
visual_en: A small 2-head tall character facing right. Dark navy wet short hair decorated with a glowing white pearl hairpin. Deep bronze skin with intense emerald eyes. Wearing a dark teal traditional Korean top. Small, luminous cyan magical water droplets float around the body. Holding a long, bright silver spear tipped with a brilliant cyan gemstone. A small mesh bag with a single harpoon attached hangs at the waist. The overall silhouette is sharp and brightly accented with cyan and gold to stand out against dark backgrounds.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing in a firm, ready-to-strike stance, eyes focused forward.
vfx_en: A few bold teal water streaks shooting forward and small droplets
lore: 해녀 작살꾼 — 멀리 꿰뚫는다. 무기 작살.
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

parent_body.body: A humanoid character with dark skin, blue hair, and green eyes, wearing a green and white garment.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
